SELECT count(*)::int
FROM fps.workgroup AS w
WHERE w.fpsyear = @ef_filter__FilterFpsYear

SELECT w.workgroup, w.fpsyear, w.centraloverhead, w.cos90, w.costcentre, w.costcentreold, w.description, w.email_recipient, w.owner, w.profitcentre, w.sendemail
FROM fps.workgroup AS w
WHERE w.fpsyear = @ef_filter__FilterFpsYear
ORDER BY w.workgroup
LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
